//: daq_subsystem is the full 8-channel chip top: 8x chan_top plus the
shared DMA engine (dma_sched/desc_fetch/axi_rd_master/axi_wr_master/
wr_track), CSR (axil_slave/daq_csr), irq_ctrl and perf_cnt. Clocking is
NOT the 3-domain split PLAN.md originally sketched: reg_clk and axi_clk
were tied together into one clk_i (see daq_subsystem.sv's own header
comment for why). The only real CDC left is each channel's own
src_clk_i[c] crossing into clk_i, handled entirely inside chan_top.sv
(prim_fifo_async + prim_rst_sync per channel, already proven at the
chan_top level). So this is clk_i plus 8 independent src_clk_i[c]
domains - 9 clocks total. See constraints/daq_subsystem.sdc.
Dependency list follows the same transitive-instantiation approach as
chan_top's (tools/wsl/86_chan_top_deps.sh): grepping every rtl/**/*.sv
file for actual module instantiations (not the phase-1 planning table,
which includes prim modules - e.g. prim_secded_39_32 for ecc - that
were never actually wired in) found only 3 prim_* instantiations chip-
wide: prim_fifo_async, prim_rst_sync (both already in chan_top's list)
and prim_arbiter_tree (new, for dma_sched's channel arbitration).
prim_arbiter_tree.sv is self-contained - it does not instantiate
prim_arbiter_ppc/prim_leading_one_ppc itself, so those aren't needed
here even though the dma_sched formal harness lists them (sby's ASSERT-
macro elaboration path pulls in more than synthesis needs). Every
`include "prim_assert*.sv/.svh"` resolves through VERILOG_INCLUDE_DIRS
the same way it silently did for chan_top - no assert file needs to be
listed explicitly.
Launched from /mnt/d/MyWork (see tools/wsl/1XX_run_daq_subsystem.sh) for
the same reason as chan_top: OpenLane won't read above its working dir,
and prim lives outside this repo.
//CLOCK_PERIOD: Seed estimate only - constraints/daq_subsystem.sdc's own create_clock
calls govern P&R and signoff. clk_i now carries dma_sched's arbitration
tree and daq_csr's write-commit path on top of everything chan_top's
axi_clk_i already had (which needed 32 ns), so 32 ns is a floor, not a
prediction - expect this to widen once real STA runs against the routed
netlist, same as chan_top did (10 -> 32 ns after root-causing two
combinational chains). src_clk_i[c] reuses chan_top's own proven 10 ns,
since each channel is a bit-for-bit repeat of the same chan_top logic
with no new combinational path added between src_clk domain elements.
//DIE_AREA: chan_top (1 channel + its async FIFO) synthesised to ~172,790 um^2 at
800x800 (27% util). daq_subsystem repeats that 8x and adds the shared
DMA engine + CSR + irq/perf blocks on top, so cell count is well over
8x chan_top's - and P&R runtime scales worse than linearly with cell
count (empirically observed going chan_ctrl -> chan_top already: ~22x
the cells took far more than 22x the runtime). 3200x3200 um budgets
~10.24M um^2; at the same ~40% target density that is headroom for
roughly 14x chan_top's cell area, which should cover 8 channels plus
the shared logic without forcing a re-run purely for area. This is a
first-pass guess, unverified until synthesis reports real cell area -
expect to revisit after the first run's floorplan/global placement logs.
